# Quaternius free editions

Selected models from Stylized Nature MegaKit Standard and Medieval Village MegaKit Standard, plus the Unity in-place FBX from Universal Animation Library Standard. Downloaded from the author's itch.io pages on 2026-10-23. Each archive includes a CC0 dedication, preserved in its respective folder. Quaternius is the artist.

- https://quaternius.com/packs/stylizednaturemegakit.html
- https://quaternius.com/packs/medievalvillagemegakit.html
- https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html

BWVR > Import free environment artwork rebuilds the normalized prefabs and shared cutout materials. Original FBX assets and texture maps remain here; generated prefabs and materials live in Assets/BWVR/Environment. Texture import size is capped at 1024; source images are preserved. Ground and cloud shapes are original procedural BWVR artwork, not supplied by these packs.

The imported animation FBX contains 43 named clips and is configured as Humanoid. Root motion is disabled in this source variant; gameplay owns creature movement. Inclusion alone does not mean every action has been connected to gameplay.

Bestiary Dungeon Monsters uses QAL, a different license. Its files and generated creature prefabs are kept under ignored Assets/LocalLicensedArt, not this public asset directory. Paying for Source does not establish raw-asset redistribution permission under the published QAL terms.
